doc: Format A, still form: 9:16 canvas with bands, the photo in the middle, a bold title in the top band, an optional caption in the lower band (the video form is frame_video).

title.default: when the build passes on the first try
title.doc: title text, 1-2 lines, full width in the top band

caption.doc: optional short caption in the lower band (empty = none)

photo.doc: input index of the picture, or 'clip' to leave a transparent window for a video
